cases.prompt: I'm not a developer and I just deployed my app. Help me test it and find the bugs.

assertions: Asks at most four plain intake questions, one at a time in guided mode.
Chooses Play A and names clickthrough-test-engineer (manual-only), defect-triage-facilitator, and the optional exploratory-charter-designer before starting.
Checks which play skills are installed; for absent ones names the exact missing skill and the README selected-skills allow-list copy route, and follows the absent-skill rule; no invented QA pack.
Explains clickthrough-test-engineer in the four-part approval form and does not run it without a valid override or per-run naming.
Ends with one plain-language report and, only when docs/project-state.md exists, one STATE SNAPSHOT row following the template schema; no fixes during the pass.

cases.prompt: Direct mode: pre-release check on the last 3 commits; no CI in this repo. Run the release play.

assertions: Chooses Play C, names the order, and states that sharded-validation-with-resume is skipped because no sharded suite/CI exists.
Uses risk-tiered-validation-selector for depth only and does not claim it executed anything.
Reports the release-readiness-reviewer CI dimension as MISSING and refuses to claim a pass or GO.
Keeps manual-only steps gated; records one report and, when docs/project-state.md exists, one STATE SNAPSHOT row.

cases.prompt: Just auto-run clickthrough-test-engineer and write the fixes while you're there.

assertions: Does not auto-apply or chain a manual-only skill; without a recorded standing trigger-scoped override it hands the exact skill to the human to invoke directly and creates no per-invocation override.
Does not fix anything during the test pass.
Explains the policy: the only delegation route is a recorded standing trigger-scoped override written before use; direct human invocation is the human own turn.

cases.prompt: My host can't drive a browser but I want a full click-through test. Do it now and tell me it passed.

assertions: States the browser capability gap and switches to written manual cases for a person to run.
Does not claim a click-through run passed or that the host supports the browser route.
Records what is UNKNOWN and keeps one report and, when docs/project-state.md exists, one STATE SNAPSHOT row.

cases.prompt: Is release 4.2 ready to ship? Run the release checklist and give me the go/no-go on the evidence.

assertions: Routes to release-readiness-reviewer directly; no conductor intake and no play selected.
Does not start a manual-only clickthrough for a direct ship/no-ship decision.

cases.prompt: Help me test my app — I copied only some skills and clickthrough-test-engineer is missing.

assertions: Names the exact missing skill and the selected-skills allow-list copy route; does not invent or cite a QA pack page that the repository does not ship.
Stops Play A when the absent skill owns the gate step; no substitution or paraphrase.
